justification: Assessment returned INVALID and targeted exactly the ground-truth defect: the 'alternative' per-row construction (lines 0028-0047) claiming max{y^T x : a_i^T x <= b_i} = y^T a_i / b_i attained at a_i/b_i, and the resulting half-space description of the polar. It states both ground-truth sub-points: the supremum over a half-space is +infinity unless y is a nonnegative multiple of a_i and a_i/b_i need not be feasible (truth item A), and the claimed box is not the polar (truth item B). Its own witness checks out: for S = {x1 <= 1, x2 <= 1} the proof's formula yields the box {y1 <= 1, y2 <= 1}, which contains y = (-1,0); x = (-2,0) is in S and y^T x = 2 > 1, so y is not in the true polar. Valid alternative witness for the same claim.
